hypothesis: M220 repeats the M206/M208 class of failure: fixed objective, replay, and behavior improve or retain, but a longer PPO continuation leaves the protected-key near-boundary normal-margin window. Before any more PPO, audit whether the failure is a boundary-window artifact, a true proof-surface washout, or a missing protected-surface anchor.
success_criteria: compare M219 seed5216 and M220 seed5217 on protected key 9944|perturbed|28|28
separate normal-success retention, margin-gap retention, and near-boundary normal-margin-window retention
confirm whether M220 loses the key only by normal margin exceeding 0.2
keep M219 seed5216 as current best unless a new gated candidate passes protected key
pre-register the next training or mining milestone before running any PPO
do not loosen the protected-key threshold after seeing the result
do not train the policy merely to reduce clearance on the old key
failure_criteria: run an M220 repeat before the audit is documented
promote M220 based on fixed objective or broad behavior alone
retroactively relax the protected-key acceptance window

commands.name: m221_audit
commands.command: Use M220 docs and runs/m220_critical_key_seed9944/guard_results.csv to classify the protected-key failure and pre-register the next safe milestone.

decision_rule: Only an audit that preserves the protected-key standard and pre-registers a safer continuation or fresh protected-surface refresh may unblock further PPO.
